Title: App Root Component
Summary: Root HTML document component that bootstraps the Blazor Server application.
Content:
## App.razor

**Path:** `Components/App.razor`

**Type:** Root component (no `@page` directive)

### Purpose

Renders the base HTML document (`<!DOCTYPE html>`) that hosts the Blazor Server application. This is the entry point for the browser.

### Structure

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
    <base href="/" />
    <ResourcePreloader />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="@Assets["css/bootstrap.min.css"]" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="@Assets["css/app.css"]" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="@Assets["MyBlazorApp.styles.css"]" />
    <ImportMap />
    <link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="favicon.png" />
    <HeadOutlet @rendermode="InteractiveServer" />
  </head>
  <body>
    <Routes @rendermode="InteractiveServer" />
    <ReconnectModal />
    <script src="@Assets["_framework/blazor.web.js"]"></script>
  </body>
</html>
```

### Key Elements

| Element | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| `<ResourcePreloader />` | Preloads critical resources for faster initial render. |
| `<HeadOutlet />` | Enables dynamic `<PageTitle>` and `<HeadContent>` from child components. Render mode: `InteractiveServer`. |
| `<Routes />` | The Blazor router component. Render mode: `InteractiveServer`. |
| `<ReconnectModal />` | Displays reconnection UI when the Blazor Server circuit is interrupted. |
| `blazor.web.js` | The Blazor framework script that establishes the SignalR circuit. |

### Render Mode

Both `HeadOutlet` and `Routes` use `InteractiveServer` render mode, meaning the entire app is server-rendered with interactive capabilities via SignalR.

### Notes

- This component is **not routable** — it is the root document wrapper.
- The `@Assets` directive resolves static asset paths with cache-busting.
- `lang="en"` is set on the HTML element for accessibility.
